page.overview:
What is Ferrari?

Ferrari is a licensed theme introduced in 2004.

Ferrari started as a subtheme of the Racers theme in 2004. TECHNIC cars and System cars are included in this theme. Sets involving Ferrari racing events are included as well. However, there were Ferrari LEGO products before 2004. Early in 1997, a Model Team promotional set with Shellwas released. In 1999, 2 promotional sets with Shell (1253, 1255) included Ferrari cars as well.

Since then, Ferrari sets have been released under the Speed Champions, Expert, TECHNIC and most recently, Formula 1, themes.

Two Ferrari inspired minifigures were released in LEGO Fortnite in 2025: Maranello Racer and Modena Icon.
